'''SBI Card''' (legally '''SBI Cards and Payment Services Limited''') is an Indian [[non-banking financial company]] which provides [[credit card]] issuance and related payment services, operating as a subsidiary of the [[State Bank of India]]. The company was Incorporated in 1998, as a joint venture between SBI and [[GE Capital]]. The company is headquartered in [[Gurugram]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=2025-06-11 |title=Profits down 20%, but India's #2 credit card player is doubling down: What's SBI Cards' big bet? |url=https://indianexpress.com/article/smart-stocks/profits-down-india-2-credit-card-player-doubling-down-sbi-card-big-bet-10059810/ |access-date=2026-04-06 |website=The Indian Express |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=SBI Card, Google Pay Partner To Launch Fully Digital 'Flex SBI Card'; Offer Rs 1,000 Welcome Benefits |url=https://www.ndtvprofit.com/business/new-google-pay-flex-sbi-card-offers-rs-1-000-welcome-benefit-upi-access-and-up-to-18-000-annual-rewards-11838652}}</ref>

== History ==
SBI Card was started in 1998 as a joint venture between the [[State Bank of India]] and [[GE Capital]]. The company reached one million cards in 2002 and two million cards by 2005. In 2020 SBI Card completed Initial Public Offering, becoming the first credit card company to be listed in Indian stock market. As of September 2025, SBI Card has over 20 million cards.<ref>{{Cite web |last=G |first=Seetharaman |date=2025-07-30 |title=SBI Cards can't find a way out of its funk |url=https://the-ken.com/long_and_short/sbi-cards-cant-find-a-way-out-of-its-funk/ |access-date=2026-04-09 |website=The Ken |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |title=Virus Panic Weighs on India's Blockbuster Credit Card IPO |url=https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2020-03-03/virus-panic-weighs-on-india-s-blockbuster-credit-card-ipo |work=[[Bloomberg L.P.|Bloomberg]]}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Singh |first=Shipra |date=2024-04-29 |title=Does SBI Card's new credit card go the extra mile for travellers? |url=https://www.livemint.com/money/personal-finance/why-the-newly-launched-sbi-card-miles-credit-card-is-not-up-to-the-mark-11714303326111.html |access-date=2026-04-09 |website=mint |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Rediff On The NeT Business News: SBI pulls out trump card, hopes to take credit for plastic smiles |url=https://m.rediff.com/money/1998/oct/22sbi.htm |access-date=2026-04-09 |website=m.rediff.com}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |date=2006-08-31 |title=SBI Card becomes 2nd largest credit card co |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/banking/finance/banking/sbi-card-becomes-2nd-largest-credit-card-co/articleshow/1944000.cms?from=mdr |access-date=2026-04-09 |work=The Economic Times |issn=0013-0389}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=SBI Card Standalone June 2026 Net Sales at Rs 5,040.55 crore, up 3.36% Y-o-Y |url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/earnings/sbi-card-standalone-june-2026-net-sales-at-rs-5040-55-crore-up-3-36-y-o-y-13992089.html/amp}}</ref>
